title: Dr. Post-Training: A Data Regularization Perspective on LLM Post-Training
authors_zh: Pingbang Hu、Xueshen Liu、Z. Morley Mao、Jiaqi W. Ma（伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳—香槟分校、密歇根大学）
paper_type_zh: 后训练数据正则化与优化目标研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要同时利用少量高保真目标数据与大量通用数据的后训练研究者。
one_line: Dr. Post-Training uses general data as a feasible-set regularizer for target post-training updates.
该方法将通用训练数据视为目标后训练更新的可行方向约束，而非一次性筛选的样本池。
why: It makes data consumption part of the optimization geometry rather than a one-time selection decision.
inclusion_reason: Recasts how general data constrains SFT, RLHF, and RLVR updates, rather than treating selection as a static preprocessing step.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Post-training commonly combines a small target dataset with a much larger general corpus. Static selection asks which general records to keep, but it does not express how that corpus should constrain an update aimed at a scarce target objective; target-only training can overfit, while indiscriminate mixing can pull the model away from the desired behavior.

Dr. Post-Training asks how to use general data without reducing it to a selected subset. It defines target data as the desired update direction and general data as a feasible set of update directions, then projects the former onto the latter at each training step for SFT, RLHF, and RLVR.

后训练经常需要把少量目标数据与规模大得多的通用语料结合。静态筛选只问应保留哪些通用记录，却没有说明该语料应如何约束一个面向稀缺目标的更新；只用目标数据可能过拟合，而不加区分地混合又可能把模型拉离预期行为。

Dr. Post-Training 追问如何使用通用数据，而不把它降格为一个被选中的子集。它将目标数据定义为期望更新方向，将通用数据定义为可行更新方向集合，并在每个训练步中把前者投影到后者上，用于 SFT、RLHF 和 RLVR。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is data-induced regularization. General records do not compete with target records for inclusion; their gradients define directions that an update is permitted to follow, while the target objective supplies the direction the model wants to take. This reframes data use as a geometric constraint on optimization.

The data object is therefore a record together with its contribution to a layerwise gradient or feasible-update set. A projected update is accepted because it remains compatible with general-data structure while following the target objective. The closest alternatives are static top-k, threshold, or greedy selection rules, which are special approximations in the paper's broader feasible-set view.

核心思想是由数据诱导的正则化。通用记录不再与目标记录争夺是否入选；它们的梯度定义更新被允许遵循的方向，而目标目标函数提供模型希望前进的方向。这把数据使用重新定义为对优化过程施加的几何约束。

因此，数据对象是一条记录及其对逐层梯度或可行更新集合的贡献。一个投影后的更新之所以被采用，是因为它在追随目标目标函数的同时仍与通用数据的结构兼容。最接近的替代方案是静态 top-k、阈值或贪心筛选规则；在论文更广泛的可行集合视角中，它们只是不同的近似。

title: Method
方法
html:
At each step, the method computes the update requested by scarce target data and builds a feasible set from gradients on general data. It projects the target update onto that set, then applies the projected direction. The paper derives subset, threshold, and greedy constructions as tractable ways to instantiate the feasible set and also gives group-wise and layer-wise variants.

The authors evaluate the scaffold in SFT, RLHF, and RLVR, keeping held-out evaluation data disjoint from regularization and training data and averaging results over five seeds unless otherwise stated. Practical reproduction must decide whether a rule decomposes across micro-batches: thresholding can be resolved locally, while top-k requires global statistics and may need two passes or more memory.

每一步中，该方法先计算稀缺目标数据要求的更新，再由通用数据上的梯度构造可行集合。它把目标更新投影到该集合上，然后应用投影后的方向。论文推导出子集、阈值和贪心构造作为实例化可行集合的可处理方法，并给出分组和逐层变体。

作者在 SFT、RLHF 和 RLVR 中评测该框架，并使留出评测数据与正则化和训练数据分离；除非另有说明，结果取五个随机种子的平均。实际复现时必须判断规则是否能跨微批次分解：阈值可以局部求解，而 top-k 需要全局统计量，可能需要两次遍历或更多内存。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates the framework across SFT, RLHF, and RLVR and reports consistent downstream-performance and convergence improvements against data-selection baselines. In SFT, it fine-tunes Llama-3.2-1B on four training/target pairs and reports that its layer-wise subset update outperforms the stated online data-selection baseline; the reported tests are held out from both training and regularization.

This is stronger evidence than a single SFT result because the same update principle is exercised under three post-training objectives. It is not proof that every general dataset is a helpful regularizer: the effect depends on the target/general pairing, gradient approximation, feasible-set rule, and system memory budget, all of which need to be matched in a reuse study.

论文在 SFT、RLHF 和 RLVR 中评测该框架，并报告相对数据选择基线在下游表现和收敛速度上都有稳定改进。在 SFT 中，它以四组训练/目标任务对微调 Llama-3.2-1B，并报告其逐层子集更新优于文中采用的在线数据选择基线；所报告的测试集同时与训练和正则化数据分离。

这比单一 SFT 结果更有力，因为同一更新原则在三种后训练目标下都被检验。但这并不证明每个通用数据集都是有益的正则器：效果取决于目标/通用数据配对、梯度近似、可行集合规则与系统内存预算，复用研究必须匹配这些条件。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Conventional data selection decides which samples enter training. Dr. Post-Training instead changes the optimization role of data that remains available: general records regularize the direction of a target update even when they are not the selected target batch.

Gradient projection and data selection are not new independently. The novelty is a common feasible-set formulation that makes selection methods special cases and extends the same design to SFT, RLHF, and RLVR. Before reuse, compare the projected and unprojected update norms, verify target/general split provenance, and test whether correlated general-data gradients collapse the feasible space.

传统数据选择决定哪些样本进入训练。Dr. Post-Training 改变的是仍可访问数据在优化中的角色：即使通用记录并非被选中的目标 batch，它们仍会正则化目标更新的方向。

梯度投影和数据选择各自都不是新概念。新意在于一个统一的可行集合表述：它把选择方法视为特例，并把相同设计扩展到 SFT、RLHF 和 RLVR。复用前应比较投影与未投影更新的范数，核验目标/通用划分的来源，并测试高度相关的通用数据梯度是否会使可行空间塌缩。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method requires gradient-level access to both target and general streams and can impose substantial memory or extra-pass cost, especially for rules requiring batch-global top-k statistics. Its guarantee is about the geometry induced by the available general data, not the truth or safety of that data; a biased or poorly matched corpus can constrain learning in the wrong direction. The reported code is public, but no dedicated new dataset is released, so exact data mixtures and their licenses must be reconstructed from the paper and upstream sources.
该方法需要同时访问目标流和通用流的梯度，并可能带来较大的内存或额外遍历成本，尤其是需要全 batch top-k 统计的规则。它的保证针对可用通用数据诱导出的几何结构，而非这些数据的真实性或安全性；有偏或不匹配的语料可能把学习约束到错误方向。论文公开了代码，但未发布专门的新数据集，因此精确的数据混合及其许可证必须从论文和上游来源中重建。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a post-training project has a small, high-confidence target signal but also a large general pool that should preserve broad behavior. Define the target objective and the general-data stream separately, choose a feasible-set construction that fits the memory budget, and compare projected, target-only, and ordinary mixed-data updates on held-out tasks. It is not a substitute for auditing general-data quality, and it is unsuitable when gradients, split boundaries, or the system budget cannot be controlled.
当后训练项目拥有少量高置信目标信号，同时还有应保留广泛行为的大型通用池时，可以使用这项工作。应分别定义目标目标函数和通用数据流，选择符合内存预算的可行集合构造，并在留出任务上比较投影更新、仅目标更新和普通混合数据更新。它不能替代对通用数据质量的审计；当无法控制梯度、划分边界或系统预算时，也不适用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember the distinction between selecting examples and constraining updates with examples. The target data says where to move; general data says which moves remain feasible. Treat top-k and thresholding as design points, not the full method. The paper's evidence spans SFT, RLHF, and RLVR, but every deployment still needs a target/general compatibility test. Reproduce the micro-batch implementation because it changes the actual optimization rule.
应记住“选择样本”与“用样本约束更新”的区别。目标数据说明应向哪里移动；通用数据说明哪些移动仍然可行。top-k 和阈值只是设计点，不是完整方法。论文的证据跨越 SFT、RLHF 和 RLVR，但每次部署仍需进行目标/通用数据兼容性测试。还应复现微批次实现，因为它会改变实际采用的优化规则。
